scripts.package: python3 -c "import zipfile, os; zipf = zipfile.ZipFile('setinel-tech-theme.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zipf.write(os.path.join(r, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, f), '.')) for r, d, files in os.walk('setinel-tech-theme') for f in files]; print('Updated setinel-tech-theme.zip')"
